title: Soul Feast #47: What to Do about Polarization in My Family or Workplace?
excerpt: Learn how to align your personality with your soul and create authentic power in your life.
bodyHtml:
Learn how to align your personality with your soul and create authentic power in your life. The Authentic Power Guidelines will guide you on this powerful journey. Learn More Here.

In this eye-opening episode of The Gary Zukav Deepcast, Gary explores the rising tension of polarization in our families, workplaces, communities, and across the globe. He offers a perspective from the new consciousness: we cannot change polarization “out there,” but we can transform our internal experience of it – starting with our own reactions and perceptions. With clarity and compassion, Gary reframes division not as an external battle, but as a reflection of our inner state.

At the heart of polarization is a choice.

When you experience judgment, frustration, or anger, you are reacting from a frightened part of your personality. The pursuit of external power is the attempt to fix others or the world. Gary invites you to instead use your emotional awareness to see your own inner divides. Polarization is a feature of duality in the Earth school. You cannot eradicate it, but you can make a responsible choice about which part of your personality you act from: a frightened part or a loving part.

The path to healing the division you see in the world is the creation of authentic power and the alignment of your personality with your soul. That journey begins with your emotional awareness and your responsible choice. When you choose to look inward, you cultivate the loving parts of your personality, like patience, gratitude, and compassion. This is how you contribute to a more loving world, because what is in one, is in the whole.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:42) — Why You Can’t Fix Polarization Out There: The only place to change polarization is within yourself

(03:09) — The Myth of External Power: Why trying to change others comes from fear—and why it no longer works in the new multisensory consciousness

(05:50) — Love or Fear? The Only Two Options: How every experience brings you to a choice point between love and fear

(08:14) — The Power of Perception: Why “others” are projections—and how recognizing this shifts your experience of life

(13:24) — Creating Authentic Power: What it means to align with your soul and evolve spiritually

(18:13) — Your Role in Polarized Environments: A new way to respond in families, workplaces, and society at large

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

This week, carry a small notebook with you. Each time you experience frustration, fear, or judgment about polarization – whether in your family, workplace, or society – write it down. Note which frightened part of your personality is reacting. Ask yourself: Am I choosing fear or love? At the end of the week, reflect on your notes. You can’t remove duality from the Earth School, but you can choose which side of it you live from. Choose love.
